defects.name: fake_canonical_path
defects.description: LGAERuntime.step() delegates all real work to StructuralLearningLoop.step(). The 8 phase methods (observe, reason, propose, plan, evaluate, authorize, commit, learn) exist but are never called during step(). They are decorative.

defects.name: guard_mutability
defects.description: AuthoritativeStateGuard.graph returns raw mutable GraphBuffers. Callers can do guard.graph.weight[...] = ... to mutate authoritative state, bypassing the authority model.

defects.name: production_failopen
defects.description: Production mode only checks require_signed_receipts + signing_key. Does not check WAL, evidence store, checkpointing, qualification bundle. Can start without persistence.

defects.name: hash_seed_nondeterminism
defects.description: curriculum.py uses hash(family.value) which is non-deterministic across PYTHONHASHSEED values.

defects.name: mpc_not_called
defects.description: MPC planner is instantiated in __init__ when horizon > 1 but step() delegates to loop.step() which never uses it. MPC is dead code.

defects.name: information_gain_not_used
defects.description: structural_loop.py hardcodes information_gain=0.0, cost=0.0, risk=0.0. The IG module exists but is never wired into action selection.

defects.name: manifest_mismatch
defects.description: MANIFEST.sha256.json still references v5.9.0 schema and does not cover new v5.10 files.
